opportunities.name: Wall scream mage
opportunities.objective: Use Head Rush to line up an AP wall collision.
opportunities.mechanic: Chilling Scream has 1 AP magic damage on release and 2.4 AP magic wall-hit damage when fully charged; Certain Death landing adds 1.3 AP magic. Rocketbelt helps create the wall angle, Gunblade offers mixed stats and a slowing active, and magic penetration serves E/R. Q's AP term deals physical damage, so it is secondary here.
opportunities.requiredState: Need a nearby wall, uninterrupted full E charge and a planned frenzy cancellation.
opportunities.failure: Charging gives targets time to sidestep; weak physical sustained damage makes a failed wall hit costly.
opportunities.test: Measure release versus wall bonus separately, then compare realistic Q-to-wall sequences against a dodging target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP does not strengthen W's main AD attack loop or make Q magic damage.

opportunities.name: Bleed health conversion
opportunities.objective: Convert actual healing windows and health into physical pressure.
opportunities.mechanic: Crimson Curse stacks physical bleed to five and heals from pre-mitigation bleed; W recast restores health from its damage and a max-health term. Bloodmail converts bonus health to AD, Visage enhances self healing, and Cleaver targets the physical loop. E's max-health heal and reduction can stabilize a dangerous low-health recast before Death's Dance requires a real takedown.
opportunities.requiredState: Need controlled W access, an E escape and a living target for bleed ticks.
opportunities.failure: Anti-heal, forced target selection and instant burst can prevent the expected sustain.
opportunities.test: Compare healing and survival over one W/E cycle, with and without healing reduction and fixed health.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Bleed stacks are capped; self-taunt is a positioning liability, not free permanent uptime.

ruledOut.reason: Crimson Curse's bleed uses an AD statFormula expression rather than an AP ratio.

unknowns: AD statFormula=2 and health stat IDs are preserved symbolically; wall damage additive handling needs testing.

testPlan: Required state: Need a nearby wall, uninterrupted full E charge and a planned frenzy cancellation.
Measure release versus wall bonus separately, then compare realistic Q-to-wall sequences against a dodging target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Charging gives targets time to sidestep; weak physical sustained damage makes a failed wall hit costly.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP does not strengthen W's main AD attack loop or make Q magic damage.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Gunblade, Hextech Rocketbelt, Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Briar leaps and enters a Blood Frenzy, self-taunting to the nearest enemy for [5] seconds, prioritizing Champions. While in Blood Frenzy she gains [(0.55 / 0.65 / 0.75 / 0.85 / 0.95) × 100]% Attack Speed and [(0.24 / 0.33 / 0.42 / 0.51 / 0.6) × 100]% Move Speed, and her Attacks deal [(0.6 / 0.7 / 0.8 / 0.9 / 1) × AD] physical damage to enemies surrounding her target.

Briar can Recast this Ability to empower her next Attack. It deals [5 / 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 + (1.05) × AD] + [9 + (0.025) × AD[statFormula=2]]% missing Health physical damage and heals Briar for [(0.05) × Stat(12)] + [(0.24 / 0.28 / 0.32 / 0.36 / 0.4) × 100]% of the damage dealt.

Briar leaps to a target, Stunning it for [0.85] seconds, dealing [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.6) × AP + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and reducing [(0.1 / 0.125 / 0.15 / 0.175 / 0.2) × 100]% Armor and Magic Resist for [5] seconds.

Briar will stop prioritizing champions if she casts this Ability on a minion or monster during Blood Frenzy.

Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone and flies to the location of the first champion it hits, marking them as her prey. On landing, she deals [150 / 250 / 350 + (1.3) × AP] magic damage to everything nearby and causes enemies who are not her prey to Flee for [1.5] seconds. She then enters an empowered Blood Frenzy and will pursue her prey until death. During this time, she gains [(0.2) × AD] Armor and Magic Resist, [(0.1 / 0.15 / 0.2) × 100]% Lifesteal, and an additional [(0.1 / 0.2 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed.

Begin Charging: Briar removes Blood Frenzy and gathers energy, gaining [35]% damage reduction and restoring [(0.1 / 0.115 / 0.13 / 0.145 / 0.16) × Stat(12)] Health over 1 second.

Release: Briar unleashes a scream that deals up to [80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1) × AP] magic damage based on time charged, and Slows by [80]% for [0.5] seconds. When fully charged, the scream Knocks Back enemies, dealing [140 / 215 / 290 / 365 / 440 + (2.4) × AD[statFormula=2] + (2.4) × AP] magic damage to those who hit a wall and Stunning them for [1.5] seconds.
